summary.text: Natalie Fleming is an Independent candidate for U.S. Senate from Idaho. She describes herself as a rancher's daughter and mother with a background in software and information technology, and an author of two books. Her campaign focuses on limits on surveillance and AI, housing affordability and restoring the water cycle.

paragraphs.text: Born in Portland, Oregon, and describes herself as a rancher's daughter from Idaho's high desert.
Graduated from Moscow High School and returned to Idaho in 2002 as a single mother, working in software while caring for family members with special needs, by her own account.

Earned a bachelor's degree from Boise State University in 2024, with degrees she describes as in Information Technology Management, Supply Chain Management and Cybersecurity, after returning to school during COVID.
Her career experience includes work as an information technology professional.
Has written two books, one on defying hate propaganda and one on restoring the water cycle.
